text:
laura-sales: HelixBank security asked if a 30-day POC can be scoped out of hosted API and run on Dedicated or Private only.

nathan-iso: Yes  we can limit ISMS evidence to the POC environment but must state the boundary in the SoA.

alex.eng: Note: Dedicated still touches our control plane for telemetry unless it's Private VPC. If they require zero hosted routing, choose Private.

priya-se: Typical evidence requests: SoA, ISMS policy, KMS proof, dataflow, retention/deletion, access controls, network diagram.

laura-sales: They asked for SoA, ISMS policy, KMS integration evidence, POC data flows, deletion guarantees, and an applicability statement excluding hosted API.

nathan-iso: Suggested SoA snippet: "Scope: ISO/IEC 27001 controls apply to Redwood Dedicated GPU pool and customer-dedicated resources provisioned for HelixBank POC 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31. Hosted/shared control plane components are excluded."

jamie-cto: If hosted control plane is excluded, we must also scope logs/metrics and offer a deletion runbook. Engineering needs a ticket to verify purge.

alex.eng: For Dedicated POC we can isolate tenant, enable tenant-specific KMS keys, provide dataflow diagram, and run key deletion at POC end. Private VPC adds ~2 weeks lead time.

priya-se: I'll draft a one-page applicability statement and checklist for HelixBank to sign off.

laura-sales: Also need a pricing estimate for a 30-day Dedicated POC with isolation + KMS. Give me a placeholder while we wait for qps.

jamie-cto: Suggest estimated fee = reserved capacity + eng support. Laura f capture qps so we can size GPUs.

laura-sales: Will collect qps today and update.

nathan-iso: Security next steps: 1) Draft SoA snippet and applicability statement (I can own) 2) Gather evidence items and sample artifacts 3) Confirm deletion runbook and owner. Target: EOD tomorrow.

priya-se: I'll post the draft into this thread when ready.

laura-sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update HelixBank and post follow-up after qps.
